subject: Private Offer: commit thresholds, trigger windows & ops runway
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@cloudbridge.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Google Partner Eng <partner-eng@google.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP private offer: proposed commit thresholds + trigger windows

Hi Camila / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this week — CloudBridge is excited to finish the private offer paperwork. Attached is a first-pass schedule that maps commit tiers to monthly drawdown triggers. Two items we need your operations team's guidance on before we finalize:

- Threshold gating: our finance team expects a 3-tier trigger (10%, 50%, 90%) for frontload eligibility. We want to confirm you can support automatic tier detection and a grace window for SKU reconciliation.
- Escrow/fallback timing: if a customer doesn't hit the 90% trigger by month 10, CloudBridge prefers a 30-day notice and partial refund rather than abrupt cutover. Google PM flagged that Marketplace refunds require a specific invoice path.

I attached commit_schedule_v1.xlsx and a short SOW draft with a proposed frontload clause. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a soft-90% trigger with a 30-day remediation? If not, what operational signal would you prefer to avoid manual intervention?

Best,
Amit
Partner Sales | CloudBridge
[Attachment: commit_schedule_v1.xlsx]
[Attachment: sow_frontload_terms_draft.pdf]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: proposed commit thresholds + trigger windows

Hi Amit — thanks for the clear deck and schedule. High-level response below; I copied Vivek for any commercial exceptions.

1) Threshold gating: we can support a three-tier approach operationally. Our runtime can emit a monthly "consumption checkpoint" file to the partner (secure URL) on day 3 of each month. That checkpoint should be sufficient to evaluate the 10/50/90 buckets without manual reconciliation.

2) Grace window & remediation: a 30-day remediation is reasonable as long as:
   - the checkpoint confirms >=50% of the expected run-rate for two consecutive months before month 10, or
   - the partner agrees to a prorated partial refund schedule in the SOW.

3) Billing path: please route marketplace refund flows through Google billing (partner-eng@google.com is CC'd) — Redwood will not process refund credits outside of the Marketplace invoicing workflow.

Next steps I propose:
- Amit: update commit_schedule_v1.xlsx to include the checkpoint day and the prorated refund formula (if you want the frontload option).
- Marissa: can you review the SOW draft and confirm we can accept the frontload language with the Google billing caveat?

Thanks,
Camila
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: commit_schedule_v1.xlsx]

From: Amit Shah <amit@cloudbridge.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Google Partner Eng <partner-eng@google.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: proposed commit thresholds + trigger windows

Thanks Camila — that sounds workable. I've updated the schedule to add a Day-03 checkpoint column and a simple prorated formula for refunds (see commit_schedule_v1.xlsx, tab "Triggers"). Two clarifying items:

- For the checkpoint file, can Redwood accept an authenticated signed URL with read-only access for 72 hours? Our finance ops automation will pick that up and calculate party-level consumption.
- For the refund formula, we'd like the option to frontload up to 25% of the first-quarter commitment if the Marketplace PO is signed within 14 days of the DocuSign link. Is that an exception Redwood would consider?

I'll attach a cleaned SOW with the frontload clause included if you want to review.

—Amit
[Attachment: commit_schedule_v1.xlsx]
[Attachment: sow_frontload_terms_draft.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Amit Shah <amit@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: proposed commit thresholds + trigger windows

Camila / Amit — quick ops and commercial note from my side:

- Signed URL: yes, our ingestion pipeline can consume a signed read-only URL for 72 hours. Please ensure the CSV layout follows our checkpoint schema (I'll drop the schema to the Drive link below).
- Frontload request: commercial OK to entertain 25% frontload but needs a short legal review and a limited amortization schedule (6 months max for recognition). We cannot accept open-ended frontloads tied only to DocuSign timing.
- Marketplace invoicing: confirm final SOW references "Google Marketplace billing flow" and includes the specific invoice line items so the upstream billing team can map credits correctly.

I'll add the checkpoint schema and a one-pager on amortization to the shared doc. Camila — if you approve, I'll circulate the redlined SOW to legal.

Marissa
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: gcp_po_template.docx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Amit Shah <amit@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: proposed commit thresholds + trigger windows

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Camila / Marissa: please proceed with the redline and legal review. Operationally, accept the Day-03 checkpoint ingestion and the 30-day remediation process. Commercially, I approve a conditional 20% frontload (not 25%) with a 6-month amortization and a hard stop at month 12 if triggers are not met.

Amit — please circulate the updated SOW and the checkpoint CSV sample to the Drive link and mark the HubSpot deal as "Pending legal review - frontload exception". Once legal signs off on the redline, we'll send the DocuSign link and confirm Marketplace billing items.

Vivek
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
